name: Butternut Squash, Prosciutto & Blue Cheese Flatbread with Arugula

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh sage
1 ½ small butternut squash
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and finely chop the leaves. Place in a large bowl.

Trim and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and small dice. Add to the bowl with the sage along with oil, salt, and pepper; stir to coat. Divide squash between baking sheets and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, rotating the baking sheets and stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions into half-moons.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, working in batches if necessary, add prosciutto slices and cook until crispy, about 1 minute per side. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate and set aside.
Return skillet to medium heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom; add onion, water, and salt. Cook, stirring frequently, until onions are soft and golden brown, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, honey, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp red wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp honey
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Crumble or chop the crispy prosciutto into bite-sized pieces.

Carefully remove cooked squash from the baking sheets by lifting the corners of the foil and transferring the whole sheets to a flat surface. (Stack foil layers one on top of the other if counter space is limited.)
Divide flatbreads between the baking sheets; layer with onion, squash, prosciutto, and blue cheese. Place in the oven and bake until flatbreads are golden and cheese is melted, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 flatbreads or naan
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled blue cheese

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add arugula to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine.
When the flatbreads are done, remove from oven, and top each with a small handful of arugula. (Reserve remaining arugula for serving.)
Divide flatbreads between plates; serve with remaining arugula on the side and enjoy!
